title: Full Payoff Payments on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
**Payoff desk reference — Home Comfort Financing.**

A borrower who pays the account off in full pays the payoff figure, and that payment closes the account as paid off on the day it is made.

## When the payoff figure is fixed

The payoff figure is fixed only after the account carries the late fee owed for every statement period whose installment stayed unpaid past its grace period. The payoff figure is not fixed until the account carries the post-promotional interest charge for every statement period that closed after the promotion ended.

Read against the account's records, the payoff figure stands on an account that shows a late fee for each statement period whose installment stayed unpaid past its grace period and, on a promotional plan whose promotion has ended, a post-promotional interest charge for each statement period that closed after the promotion ended.

## The payoff payment: `submit_payoff_payment_45ecd350`

**Capability.** With `submit_payoff_payment_45ecd350` the borrower pays off their own Home Comfort Financing account in full and closes it. The payment is drawn today by the method the borrower chooses and posts to the account as a payment line with a new confirmation number; the balance owed is cleared to 0.00 and the account becomes paid off, with today's date as its closing date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `submit_payoff_payment_45ecd350` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | reference number of the borrower's financing account being paid off, as the agent reads it from the financing account lookup and hands it over | identifier |
| `amount` | the payoff amount the borrower pays, exactly as the agent states it | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |
| `payment_method` | how the borrower pays | one of the values below |

`payment_method` takes exactly one of:

- `autopay_ach` — the payment is drawn under the borrower's standing automatic-payment authorization;
- `online_ach` — the borrower pays once from a checking or savings account by routing and account number;
- `debit_card` — the borrower pays once with a debit card;
- `check` — the borrower pays by a paper check that has been received;
- `phone_payment` — a customer care agent keys the payment in on the borrower's behalf during a call.

**Return.** The receipt carries `finance_txn_id` (reference number of the payment line), `payment_reference` (confirmation number of the payment), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount paid), `payment_method` (the method used), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD date the payment posted), `account_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, always 0.00 once paid off), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD closing date) and `status`. The payment has gone through when `status` reads `paid_off`.
